Class SimpleActionRegistry

java.lang.Object
io.github.kaivian.klibrary.action.impl.SimpleActionRegistry
All Implemented Interfaces:
ActionRegistry
public class SimpleActionRegistry extends Object implements ActionRegistry
Default implementation of the ActionRegistry.

Stores action factories in a case-insensitive map (all keys normalized to lowercase). Thread-safe for concurrent registration and lookup.

This is the standard registry used by KLibrary. External plugins interact with it through the ActionRegistry interface.

    • register

      public void register(String key, ActionFactory factory)
      Registers an action factory under the given type key.

      If a factory is already registered for the given key, it will be replaced and a warning will be logged.

      Specified by:
      register in interface ActionRegistry
      Parameters:
      key - the type key (case-insensitive, e.g., "message", "give_money")
      factory - the factory that creates action instances
